text.en: The ledger lists two chests. Where's the other one?
text.zh-CN: 账簿上记着两箱。另一箱在哪儿？

text.en: It was separated from us at the ferry.
text.zh-CN: 在渡口时，和我们分开了。

text.en: Separated? Gold usually needs help with that.
text.zh-CN: 分开了？黄金通常得有人帮忙，才会自己走开。

text.en: We had more volunteers than we needed.
text.zh-CN: 那会儿，热心帮忙的人有点太多。

text.en: Mother. We found you.
text.zh-CN: 母亲。找到你了。

text.en: And you've brought our volunteer.
text.zh-CN: 还把我们的热心人带来了。

text.en: You know this traveler?
text.zh-CN: 你认识这位旅人？

text.en: We disagreed at the ferry. The parcel is still sealed.
text.zh-CN: 我们在渡口起过争执。包裹还封着。

text.en: Show them the parcel. Slowly, this time.
text.zh-CN: 把包裹拿给他们看看。这次，动作慢一点。

text.en: Here. Sealed, as promised. But whose gold was this before the thieves found it?
text.zh-CN: 在这里。按说好的，一直封着。不过，这黄金在落入窃贼手里之前，到底是谁的？

text.en: That's what we're checking.
text.zh-CN: 我们正在核对。

text.en: (A messenger leans close and whispers to Amun.)
text.zh-CN: （一名传信人走近，向阿蒙低语了几句。）

text.en: Someone at the gate has a very loud opinion. Let's hear it.
text.zh-CN: 门口有人，意见很响亮。去听听吧。

text.en: I was afraid we'd arrived during the quiet part.
text.zh-CN: 我就担心，我们刚才赶上的已经算是安静时候了。

text.en: You can't walk in and claim a guarded chest.
text.zh-CN: 不能一进门，就要求带走看管着的箱子。

text.en: The villages that lost it won't be impressed by a locked door.
text.zh-CN: 丢了这笔钱的村民，可不会因为门锁得好就满意了。

text.en: Easy. I recovered it from thieves. I'm not handing it to the next loud voice.
text.zh-CN: 别急。我从窃贼那里追回了它，总不能谁声音大就交给谁。

text.en: (She notices Horus.) Horus? Still getting into trouble before breakfast?
text.zh-CN: （她看见荷鲁斯。）荷鲁斯？又是还没吃早饭，就先惹上麻烦了？

text.en: Hathor. I was hoping this visit would be less eventful.
text.zh-CN: 哈索尔。我还希望，这次来能平静些。

text.en: That would be a first.
text.zh-CN: 那可真是头一回了。

text.en: So you're acquainted. Friendship isn't proof of ownership.
text.zh-CN: 原来你们认识。可朋友关系，不是认领凭据。

text.en: Then let us hear the claim. We can argue about manners afterward.
text.zh-CN: 那就先把来由说清楚。礼数的事，可以稍后再争。

text.en: If you're carrying it back, show the wardens you can protect it.
text.zh-CN: 要由你们带回去，就先向守卫证明，你们护得住它。

text.en: Every day it sits here is another day the villages go without supplies.
text.zh-CN: 它在这里多放一天，村里就得多等一天补给。

text.en: Then let's settle this. Wardens, take your positions.
text.zh-CN: 那就把这件事定下来。守卫，就位。

text.en: The claim is clear enough. Can we get back on the road?
text.zh-CN: 来由已经说清楚了。我们能重新上路了吗？

text.en: Hathor, stay close. We haven't finished sorting this out.
text.zh-CN: 哈索尔，先别走远。事情还没说完。

text.en: Not yet. Bes, bring in the outer watch.
text.zh-CN: 还不行。贝斯，叫外围守卫过来。

text.en: On your feet! Full formation!
text.zh-CN: 都起来！完整阵势，就位！

text.en: Of course. The argument has reinforcements.
text.zh-CN: 果然。连这场争论，都还有援军。

text.en: Can we agree that the gold is leaving with us?
text.zh-CN: 现在能同意，由我们把黄金带走了吧？

text.en: (Amun closes the hall's ledger.)
text.zh-CN: （阿蒙合上了会馆的账簿。）

text.en: (Bes lowers his signal horn.)
text.zh-CN: （贝斯放下了传令的号角。）

text.en: (Sinuhe makes a very small note in the margin.)
text.zh-CN: （辛努赫在页边，很小地记了一笔。）

text.en: (Ra studies the ceiling.)
text.zh-CN: （拉开始研究天花板。）

text.en: (Khonsu looks toward the door.)
text.zh-CN: （孔苏望向了门口。）

text.en: I'll take that as a yes. Let's get moving.
text.zh-CN: 那我就当作同意了。走吧。
